item.title: Salt-N-Pepa file notice of appeal over UMG lawsuit dismissal, with ‘Blurred Lines’ lawyer as counsel
item.description: Lawsuit against UMG over the copyrights to their master recordings was dismissed in January Source

item.title: Live Nation files to pause antitrust case for appeal, days after pulling public post calling for DOJ to ‘move on’ and settle
item.description: Live Nation Entertainment asks judge to pause the DOJ antitrust case while two legal questions are reviewed by an appeals court. Source

item.title: John Langford promoted to President, Asia-Pacific for AEG International
item.description: Langford will lead the development and execution of AEG’s Asia-Pacific expansion strategy across venues and real estate. Source

item.title: Why true independence in music has never been more important
item.description: The following MBW op/ed comes from Pascal Bittard, founding President of digital distributor and artist & label services company IDOL Source

item.title: Artist representatives launch ‘Say No To Suno’ campaign: ‘AI slop dilutes the royalty pools of legitimate artists from whose music this slop is derived.’
item.description: Open letter slams AI music generator Source

item.title: Donald Trump and Isaac Hayes estate reach settlement in copyright case over use of ‘Hold On, I’m Coming’
item.description: The lawsuit was originally filed in August 2024. Source

item.title: Music startup Mogul raises $5M; says it has tracked $1.5B+ in royalties for artists to date
item.description: Mogul says the funding will be used to expand its ability to serve "artists, managers, and business managers of all kinds". Source

item.title: Google acquires AI music platform – and Suno challenger – ProducerAI
item.description: Google has acquired ProducerAI, the AI music creation platform formerly known as Riffusion, bringing the startup and its team into Google Labs. Source

item.title: Rise of the Music-Making Machines
item.description: Darius Van Arman explores the threat of AI to the music-making community and how independents can best position themselves against the inevitable and rising tide of AI… Source
